item.title: U.S. Senate shelves Clarity Act before August recess; Galaxy Digital cuts passage odds to 30% with four legislative days remaining.
BlackRock, Fidelity, Goldman Sachs and Franklin Templeton publicly endorse crypto Clarity Act as Senate timeline tightens.
JPMorgan, Citi and UBS settle $1M in cross-border payments using tokenized bank deposits in BIS pilot, clearing in 80 seconds.
Morgan Stanley begins trading Ether and Solana ETPs, passing staking rewards to investors at a 0.14% fee.
Coldcard hardware wallet bug linked to theft of approximately 600 BTC ($38M), raising questions about self-custody security.
Tether's USDT faces 2-year deadline to meet GENIUS Act rules that could restrict its availability on U.S. crypto platforms.
GENIUS Act stablecoin framework turns 1; regulators still finalizing issuer KYC and capital compliance standards.
BNY expands USDC custody for institutional clients, enabling minting and redemption through Circle integration.
SEC and CFTC open joint consultation on unified portfolio margin rules for securities and derivatives markets.
MiCA 2.0 public consultation opens as BNY Mellon's Belgian unit joins Europe's crypto service provider register.
SEC approves options on spot Ethereum ETFs from BlackRock, Fidelity and others, expanding institutional hedging tools.
US and UK regulators publish joint recommendations to align stablecoin collateral rules and tokenized asset settlement standards.
Australia's Travel Rule took effect July 1, requiring identity verification on all regulated crypto exchange transfers.
Kraken parent expands tokenized equity offerings to Hong Kong, UK and South Korea listed stocks via GTN partnership.
JPMorgan, Citi and Bank of America plan tokenized deposit network for cross-border settlement, targeting 2027 launch.
